questions.scenario: A contact center stores recordings of customer support calls. For each recording, managers need a transcript that identifies each speaker and a short summary of the call.
questions.question: Which Content Understanding analyzer should you use?

options.why: Correct. prebuilt-audioSearch returns a transcript with speaker labels and a summary.
prebuilt-videoSearch is designed for video files.
prebuilt-receipt extracts fields from receipt documents.

questions.explanation: The prebuilt-audioSearch analyzer transcribes recordings, labels speakers and produces a summary.

questions.question: Which TWO outputs does the prebuilt-videoSearch analyzer provide?

options.text: Segments with start and end times
options.why: Correct. Video output is divided into time-based segments.

options.text: Key frames that represent each segment
options.why: Correct. Key frames are extracted as representative images.
Line items are returned by prebuilt-invoice for documents.
Content credentials are attached to generated images, not video analysis results.

questions.explanation: prebuilt-videoSearch returns segments, key frames, a transcript and descriptions of the video content.

questions.question: You need a custom field named CallSentiment that returns Positive, Neutral or Negative for each recorded call. Which configuration should you use?

options.text: A custom analyzer based on prebuilt-audio with a classify field
options.why: Correct. A classify field restricts the result to the defined sentiment values.

options.text: A custom analyzer based on prebuilt-document with an extract field
options.why: prebuilt-document is for documents, and extract applies only to documents.
gpt-image-1 generates images and does not analyze audio.

questions.explanation: Custom audio analyzers use prebuilt-audio as the base analyzer, and a fixed set of values is returned by a classify field.

questions.question: A company needs live captions displayed while a presenter is speaking during a webinar. Which service is the most appropriate?

options.text: Azure Speech in Foundry Tools real-time speech to text
options.why: Correct. Real-time speech to text produces captions as the presenter speaks.
prebuilt-videoSearch analyzes recorded videos asynchronously, not live audio.
prebuilt-audioSearch processes recorded audio files after the fact.
Image analysis does not transcribe speech.

questions.explanation: Content Understanding is intended for analyzing recorded media. Live captioning requires real-time speech to text in Azure Speech.
